title: CPR Rollboards
description: GM dashboard for chained roll tables. Drag any RollTable onto a canvas tile, click to roll, see results in an in-module drawer (no chat spam). Compose chained recipes — e.g. Gang → 6 NPCs → Job + Quirk 60% — then roll the whole tile in one click. Includes a Cyberpunk Red Mook generator that turns a rolled NPC into a drop-ready Actor when the cyberpunk-red-core system is active.
